tei:titleStmt.tei:title: Invocation by Rabbi Samuel Sale at the Democratic National Convention (9 July 1904)

tei:div.tei:head: Invocation by Rabbi Samuel Sale at the Democratic National Convention (9 July 1904)

tei:lg.tei:l: Oh Merciful and Most Gracious Father,
we seek Thy presence in this vast assembly of Thy people,
and humbly we ask Thy guidance
in the counsels of the leaders of Thy people.
Thou rulest in the destinies of nations.
Thou are enthroned in the hearts of Thy worshippers,
and we serve Thee best whose lives are devoted
to the cause of the just, the right and the true;
who give ourselves consciously in Thy name
to the cause of liberty and justice.
Oh, do Thou inspire, those who are gathered here
that they may deliberate with each other
in the spirit of wisdom and understanding,
and in the spirit of counsel,
our people may go from strength to strength,
and our land may remain what Thou has destined it to be,
the foundation of human right and human liberty.
